blocks.x: Well, we haven’t talked about how you go to L.A. You told us about Duke Ellington and you went out to L.A., but what about Gordon Parks? Let’s talk about Gordon Parks, you and Gordon Parks.

Gordon Parks had written a book about his life. An actor by the name of John Cassavetes said, “Hey, I’m in big with Warner Brothers, let me see if I can get you in.” So, he showed the story to the only remaining brother. Who is that there?
It was a woman, I don’t know who it was.
Do you want to get up?
Let’s go ahead and run this. We are ready.
